## What is Codespaces

- A full code editor that runs in your browser
- Provided by GitHub - no install needed
- Linked to a repository, with all files ready to edit
- Works like VS Code, but online

## Starting a Codespace

- Go to the repository on GitHub
- Click Code, then the Codespaces tab
- Click Create codespace on main
- Wait a minute for it to set up

## Working in a Codespace

- Edit files, run code, and see changes in the browser
- Your work is saved in the cloud
- Commits go back to the same GitHub repository
- Stop or delete the codespace when you are done

## Agents in Codespaces

- An agent is an AI helper that can edit code for you
- Ask it to fix a bug, add a feature, or explain code
- It works directly in your codespace files
- You review and keep the changes you like
